blocks.text:
It will be the first time the disgraced former BBC presenter has spoken about his 2024 conviction for making indecent images of children

Huw Edwards is to speak on television about his spectacular fall from grace for the first time, as part of a Channel 4 documentary that has followed the disgraced former BBC presenter for almost a year.

The makers of the film, Huw Edwards – Guilty, said it was a “stark exploration” of Edwards’s life after grooming allegations and his conviction for making indecent images of children. He was sentenced to six months in prison in 2024, suspended for two years.
